company_notes:
Account summary: Latentia builds an in-house customer support assistant layered on RAG. Primary goals: reduce live-agent volume by 35%, deflect simple tickets, and answer escalation-worthy queries with high precision. They expect ~15-25M short docs (kb-sized knowledge snippets) in the product index.

Architecture & priorities: embedding-based retrieval + neural reranker for top-5. Tight 99th percentile latency target: end-to-end retrieval + rerank <= 250ms for interactive web widget (aim for <=200ms during demo). Willing to trade off some cost to hit latency SLO but wants clear cost per query estimates (target <$0.015/query at 10k qps/month). Prefers serving in VPC or Private deploy with dedicated GPU pools; SSO/SAML and audit logs are must-haves.

Tech preferences: currently prototyping with an open embedding model (org-internal fork of open-embed-large) and a small transformer reranker (distil-bert style). They asked about Redwood's KV cache, prefix caching, and automatic batching behavior for short sequences. Interested in Optimize suggestions for quantization + batching to reduce cost.

Recent quotes / signals: "We need top-5 precision high enough that bots don't hallucinate — precision over recall for the UI." — Head of Product.

POC constraints: dataset includes many short support KB articles and historical tickets (PII redaction required). Must demonstrate: indexing 10M -> 25M docs, p50/p95/p99 latency, rerank top-5 MAP/precision metrics, and cost-per-query projections.

Sales notes: AE + SE demo 2026-03-02 (Fireflies ff_20260302_01). Security call 2026-02-20; IdP cert question outstanding (blocking SAML setup). Pricing ask: committed monthly tier for dedicated capacity vs burst credits for seasonal spikes. They want an illustrative runbook for canary fallback to a cheaper model when load exceeds committed capacity.

Next operational steps (short):
- Run perf POC on 10M docs (Redwood Dedicated) week of 2026-03-15
- Deliver cost-per-query sensitivity table (quantization + batch size) by 2026-03-12
- SE to validate reranker latency in warm cache vs cold cache (Priya)
- Security to confirm IdP cert window and audit-log retention (Miguel)

Open risks: embedding storage growth model not finalized; long-term retention policy for ticket history may increase storage 2-3x. If cost projection > $0.025/q they will evaluate alternative vector stores.

Staged acceptance criteria for POC:
- Indexing: ingest 10M documents at <72 hours total indexing window OR show sustained throughput for production cadence
- Latency: p99 end-to-end <250ms for 95% of test queries; reranker compute <60ms p95 when cached
- Quality: top-5 rerank precision >= 0.78 on their internal eval set
- Security: SSO + audit logs verified in test tenant
